construct: Accumulation of unfolded proteins in the ER activates PERK, an ER transmembrane kinase. Activated PERK phosphorylates eIF2α at Ser51, which inhibits eIF2B-mediated nucleotide exchange and decreases formation of the translation-initiation ternary complex, transiently reducing global protein synthesis and ER folding load.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: ER accumulation of misfolded proteins activates PERK; PERK phosphorylates eIF2α, inhibits eIF2B-dependent initiation, and rapidly reduces global translation.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: IRE1-XBP1 and ATF6 are genuine UPR arms, but they primarily drive transcriptional remodeling rather than the immediate global translation attenuation described.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The early timing before transcriptional remodeling uniquely selects PERK-mediated eIF2α phosphorylation.
